greeting: Mortal. None may challenge me who cannot answer my riddle.
So, a challenger stands before me. First, prove your mind is as sharp as your blade.
Halt. Answer my riddle, and you may face me. Fail, and you may try again... if you dare.
try_again: Wrong. Think harder, mortal. Try again.
No. That is not it. Choose again.
Hah! Foolish. Try again, little one.
Incorrect. My patience is long, but not endless. Again.
correct: Correct. Then let us see if your strength matches your wit!
You are wiser than you look. Now, face me!
Well answered. The riddle is done. The battle begins!

ddraig_goch.riddle: I eat and eat, yet I am never full. I dance without feet, and I leave only ash behind me. Give me water, and I die. What am I?

hrimwyrm.riddle: I paint every window without a brush, and I bite your fingers without teeth. I arrive in the night and flee from the morning sun. What am I?

piasa.riddle: I gather in the heavens and roar before I strike. I bring the wind, the rain and the lightning all at once. Sailors fear me, and farmers pray for me. What am I?

fafnir.riddle: Every root drinks from me, and every mountain stands on me. You walk on me each day, and one day you will rest in me. What am I?

gargouille.riddle: I have no shape, yet I take the shape of all that holds me. I carve canyons, yet I slip through your fingers. Without me, nothing lives. What am I?

mokele_mbembe.riddle: I am every leaf and every root, every beast and every bloom. No one built me, yet I built everything that grows. What am I?

ouroboros.riddle: I am the space between the stars and the hollow at the heart of nothing. Fill me, and I am no longer myself. What am I?

fairy_dragon.riddle: I dwell in toadstool rings and moonlit glades. I deal in glamour, bargains and tricks. I never tell a lie, yet I seldom tell the truth. What am I?

azi_dahaka.riddle: The more of me there is, the less you see. Light a single candle, and I flee. What am I?

ladon.riddle: My name once meant 'hidden' in an ancient tongue. I am written in runes and whispered from forbidden tomes. Scholars chase me for a lifetime and never fully hold me. What am I?

seraphim.riddle: Brighter than a torch and warmer than a hearth, I pour from the sun and shine from the holy. Shadows flee wherever I fall. What am I?

rendmaw.riddle: I am the first blow and the reckless charge, the strike that begins every fight. Defense must wait for me, but I wait for no one. What am I?

bastion.riddle: I am the shield raised high and the wall that holds. I never strike first, yet I am the reason you survive the second blow. What am I?

galewing.riddle: I win every race, yet I never run one. The cheetah has plenty of me, and the snail has none. Lightning is famous for me. What am I?

arcanum.riddle: Wands channel me, staffs store me, and wizards spend their lives learning me. I turn words into fire and wishes into storms. What am I?

fortune.riddle: A four-leaf clover is said to hold me, and gamblers pray for me. I can't be earned, only found, and I run out when you need me most. What am I?

regalia.riddle: Kings rule with me, bards charm with me, and crowds follow wherever I lead. I am neither beauty nor strength, yet I can win any room. What am I?

the_first_dragon.riddle: I was here before the first sunrise, and I will remain after the last. Mountains crumble and stars burn out, yet I do not end. How long is my reign?

the_last_dragon.riddle: I am the day that will not come and the promise that will not be kept. Ask a coward when he will fight, or ask the sun when it will rise in the west. I am always the answer. When will the Last Dragon fall?

lindworm.riddle: No flame, no frost, no storm, no shadow. I bear no mark and claim no element, yet I am still a dragon. How many influences do I hold?
